motions.item_title: Decision Report Permitting Four Dwelling Units on a Lot City-initiated Zoning By-law Amendment 2024-405, 2024-405
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That the City-initiated Official Plan Amendment to exclude multi-unit residential buildings with four units or less from the net density calculation in the low density residential designation be approved, as shown in Attachment-1 of Report 2024-405 dated December 10, 2024. That the City-initiated Zoning By-law Amendment to permit up to four units on low density residential lots be approved, as shown in Attachment-2 of Report 2024-405 dated December 10, 2024. That in accordance with Section 34 (17) of the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the minor modifications to the proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments permitting up to four units on a lot.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City-initiated Official Plan Amendment to exclude multi-unit residential buildings with four units or less from the net density calculation in the low density residential designation be approved, as shown in Attachment-1 of Report 2024-405 dated December 10, 2024.
  2. That the City-initiated Zoning By-law Amendment to permit up to four units on low density residential lots be approved, as shown in Attachment-2 of Report 2024-405 dated December 10, 2024.
  3. That in accordance with Section 34 (17) of the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the minor modifications to the proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments permitting up to four units on a lot.

motions.item_title: 37 Christie Lane - Application to Deconstruct a Cultural Heritage Resource - 2024-514
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That City Council approve the deconstruction of the Rutherford Conservatory at 37 Christie Lane on the condition that salvageable steel be retained and conserved for future use in a commemorative structure.
motions.text_html: 1. That City Council approve the deconstruction of the Rutherford Conservatory at 37 Christie Lane on the condition that salvageable steel be retained and conserved for future use in a commemorative structure.

motions.item_title: 37 Christie Lane - Application to Deconstruct a Cultural Heritage Resource - 2024-514
motions.name: Amendment to Main Motion
motions.text: That Council encourage the University of Guelph to retain to the best of their ability as much of the salvaged material from 37 Christie Lane and include and incorporate both limestone and glass into the redeveloped commemorative garden.
motions.text_html: 1. That Council encourage the University of Guelph to retain to the best of their ability as much of the salvaged material from 37 Christie Lane and include and incorporate both limestone and glass into the redeveloped commemorative garden.

motions.item_title: 37 Christie Lane - Application to Deconstruct a Cultural Heritage Resource - 2024-514
motions.name: Main Motion as Amended
motions.text: That City Council approve the deconstruction of the Rutherford Conservatory at 37 Christie Lane on the condition that salvageable steel be retained and conserved for future use in a commemorative structure. That Council encourage the University of Guelph to reuse and salvage to the best of their ability to include and incorporate both limestone and glass into the redeveloped commemorative garden.
motions.text_html:
1. That City Council approve the deconstruction of the Rutherford Conservatory at 37 Christie Lane on the condition that salvageable steel be retained and conserved for future use in a commemorative structure.
  2. That Council encourage the University of Guelph to reuse and salvage to the best of their ability to include and incorporate both limestone and glass into the redeveloped commemorative garden.
